claim: A ground-up zero-knowledge proof stack (field arithmetic through recursive proof composition) generates a million-point FRI proof round on GPU in ~9 ms, bit-identical to the reference prover, with verification fast enough to run client-side in a browser.
status_detail: The client-side-verification half of this claim is verified-public today via The Gauntlet demo; the prover performance figure is private-development.
attestation: The ~197-module proof stack, its GPU prover, and the bit-identity gates against the reference implementation run in a private repository. The 9 ms figure is a measured benchmark on our hardware, not an extrapolation.

public_traces.note: The Gauntlet: honest and forged computation proofs verified client-side in your browser -- the forged ones fail on your hardware.

how_to_upgrade_status: Planned: publish a verification package with a pinned proof artifact and the browser verifier. Counterparty verification: info@coherenceenergylabs.com.
limitations: Deployed parameterization is ~124-bit security (fp4); strict-128 requires fp5. Aggregation currently collapses low-degree arguments to one FRI; exact-identity checks remain O(N) at audit.
